title: Cars are trying to spy on you, and it's only just the beginning
ai_summary:
• Cars are increasingly equipped with AI-powered cameras and sensors to monitor road conditions and driver behavior.

• The use of this data is still unclear, fueling concerns about potential misuse for targeted advertising or insurance manipulation.
student_angle: Learn data science and AI to stay ahead in automotive industry developments, including emerging concerns about data privacy.

• IBM Cloud offers scalable infrastructure, applications, and services on demand, with a focus on AI.
• Oracle Cloud provides a broad range of cloud-based infrastructure and software services.
• SAP Cloud offers industry-specific cloud-based applications and technologies for various business needs.
• Salesforce Cloud focuses on customer relationship management (CRM) and customer service.
